sentences.text: Seldsienean was an extinct marine reptile that lived during the Middle Jurassic in England and France.
A 2024 study by Mark Young and colleagues classified this animal within the family Teleosauridae, closely related to the subgroup Aeolodontini.
Its long, thin jaws produced a fast but relatively weak bite, suggesting it was a longirostrine generalist.
This creature lived between 168.2 and 165.3 million years ago during the Bathonian stage.
